subject: Non-convergence Following inclusion of a Modindex Recommendation in Higher Order Latent Modeling

messages.author: 8fad79f76b1ae521
messages.subject: Non-convergence Following inclusion of a Modindex Recommendation in Higher Order Latent Modeling
parts:
Hello, I am trying to figure out why including a covariance between first level latent factors in my model leads to it non-converging. Here is the original code:

measure.fullTest <- '# item level
                    aware =~ PHLMS_01 + PHLMS_03 + PHLMS_05 + PHLMS_07 + PHLMS_09 +
                                     PHLMS_11 + PHLMS_13 + PHLMS_15 + PHLMS_17 + PHLMS_19
                    sav =~ SBI_02R + SBI_08R + SBI_14R + SBI_20R +
                                 SBI_05 + SBI_11 + SBI_17 + SBI_23
                    accept =~ PHLMS_02R + PHLMS_04R + PHLMS_06R + PHLMS_08R +                                                     PHLMS_10R + PHLMS_12R + PHLMS_14R + PHLMS_16R +  
                                       PHLMS_18R + PHLMS_20R
                    
                    dep =~ DASS_03 + DASS_05 + DASS_10 + DASS_13 + DASS_16 + DASS_17 + 
                                  DASS_21
                    anx =~ DASS_02 + DASS_04 + DASS_07 + DASS_09 + DASS_15 + DASS_19 + 
                                  DASS_20
                    stress =~ DASS_01 + DASS_06 + DASS_08 + DASS_11 + DASS_12 + 
                                       DASS_14  + DASS_18
                    
                    swls =~ SWLS_1 + SWLS_2 + SWLS_3 + SWLS_4 + SWLS_5
                    grat =~ GQ_1 + GQ_2 + GQ_3R + GQ_4 + GQ_5 + GQ_6R
                    shs =~ SHS_1 + SHS_2 + SHS_3 + SHS_4
                    
                    #higher order factors
                    negfun =~ dep + anx + stress
                    posfun =~ swls + grat + shs
                    '

fit.fullTest <- cfa(measure.fullTest, data=dissertation, meanstructure = TRUE,
                 std.lv = TRUE, missing = 'FIML')

I then add a theoretically sound and modindex recommended covariance:

anx ~~ stress

This addition results in the following error and non-convergence:

the optimizer (NLMINB) claimed the model converged, but not all
    elements of the gradient are (near) zero; the optimizer may not
    have found a local solution use check.gradient = FALSE to skip
    this check.

> summary(fit.fullTest, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
lavaan 0.6-9 did NOT end normally after 1053 iterations
** WARNING ** Estimates below are most likely unreliable

I believe that Lavaan automatically includes covariances between the factors in the CFA function so is the inclusion of the covariance term not actually accomplishing what I intend it to? Note: accept and aware above are not contributing to the higher order factors but will be used in the full SEM once I've got the measurement model relatively sound.

messages.author: 5b9c62b1c7cbc1e6
messages.subject: Re: Non-convergence Following inclusion of a Modindex Recommendation in Higher Order Latent Modeling
parts:
First, the defaults in cfa() might not be what you expect when you run a higher-order model. I suggest using lavaan() for this and specifying things explicitly.

But the main problem is you've taken a factor (negfun) with three indicators (dep, anx, and stress) and added a parameter estimate. Just like a first order factor with three indicators, that portion of the model is just-identified. You're using three covariances (oversimplification for now) to estimate three loadings. You can't estimate any more parameters in this sub-model without adding a constraint to re-identify it.

Pat
